description: This script checks for unresolved Git merge conflict markers within tracked files in a repository. It identifies conflict lines, lists files under Git version control, and reports any conflict markers found.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains binary data by looking for null byte (0) sequences.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Identifies lines in a string content that are conflict markers from Git merge conflicts.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Lists all files tracked by Git in the specified directory.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Checks multiple files for conflict markers and returns violations with file paths and line numbers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates conflict detection and outputs results.
